_comment: POPULATED REFERENCE manifest showing every tool AI4IA supports through the toolbox bridge. This is an EXAMPLE only: the shipped toolbox.manifest.json stays inert (empty) so the checked-in deploy is byte-for-byte unchanged. To use it, copy this to toolbox.manifest.json (or pass --manifest foundry/toolbox.manifest.example.json), prune the tools you do not want, create the referenced connections, then run scripts/provision-foundry-toolbox.py. Every tool listed here is consumed through the official-MCP APIM front door once the toolbox is added to infra/mcp-servers.json. All tools are Azure public preview.
name: ai4ia-toolbox
description: AI4IA shared Foundry toolbox (populated reference). Groups grounding, code execution, browsing, computer control, and tool search behind one APIM-fronted MCP endpoint.

tools.name: ai4ia-rag
tools.description: RAG over the AI4IA AI Search index. Requires the 'ai4ia-search' project connection.
Foundry-managed sandboxed Python (distinct from AI4IA's existing direct Responses-API code interpreter).

tools.name: custom-code-interpreter
tools.description: Custom code interpreter: runs a BYO container image in the Foundry sandbox.
Drive a hosted browser (preview; heavier isolation review recommended).
Screen/keyboard/mouse control (preview; strongest safety review recommended).
Tool search: lets the model pick from a large tool set. Add so the toolbox self-describes its tools.
